chapter_title_en: The Xingtian Formation’s Trial of Strength
chapter_seo_title: The Xingtian Formation’s Trial of Strength – Desolate Era Chapter 520
chapter_meta_description: The Grand Xia prepares for war by testing the Xingtian Formation. A thousand Celestial Immortals merge to form a god of war, and Ji Ning steps up for his turn.
og_title: Forging a God of War: Ji Ning Tests the Xingtian Formation
og_description: Watch as the Grand Xia’s ultimate weapon is calibrated by the realm’s strongest Celestial Immortals, with Ji Ning taking a late turn to prove his worth.
twitter_title: Forging a God of War: Ji Ning Tests the Xingtian Formation
twitter_description: The Grand Xia’s war machine is tested as a thousand Celestial Immortals form the god-head of the Xingtian God. Ji Ning steps into the pilot seat.

lore_anchors.definition: A massive war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals as a foundation and 1,000 Celestial Immortals as a framework, manifesting a temporary divine spirit of god-tier durability; bestowed by Xingtian the True God.

An incredibly hard material mined from the endless Chaos by True God Daofathers. It is a key refining material for top-tier treasures, and its specks of gold are near-indestructible Chaotic Gold Essence.
A headless god from Chinese mythology who, after being decapitated, used his nipples as eyes and his navel as a mouth to continue fighting. His image is the basis for the war avatar.

A powerful Pure Yang True Immortal and senior of Ji Ning. He is selected to test the Xingtian Formation and shatters six blocks of Chaotic Goldstone, tying for second place among the first half of participants.
The supreme ruler of the Grand Xia Dynasty. He personally oversees the calibration of the Xingtian Formation, running the trial with the cold authority of a strategist.
